# Font fixture

`Ubuntu-Light.ttf` is the unmodified Ubuntu Light font distributed with
`epaint_default_fonts` 0.36.2. The accompanying Ubuntu Font Licence is in `UFL.txt`.
Copyright and licensing details remain in that file and the font metadata.

This fixture is used by the Rust rasteriser tests and the C++ layout/rendering
tests. It is not an engine default font and is not copied into game builds.

Upstream: https://design.ubuntu.com/font
Distribution source: https://crates.io/crates/epaint_default_fonts/0.36.2
